subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Green thumb
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Green thumb"** means being good at growing plants. (पौधे उगाने में अच्छा होना) • **Example: **Jane has a green thumb; her garden is always full of beautiful flowers and healthy vegetables. • **"Indulging in corruption"** refers to engaging in dishonest or fraudulent conduct, typically to acquire personal gain. (भ्रष्टाचार में लिप्त होना) • **Example: **The mayor was accused of indulging in corruption after several financial irregularities were discovered. • **"To visit the vegetable market"** means going to a place where vegetables are sold. (सब्जी बाजार जाना) • **Example: **I need to visit the vegetable market to buy fresh produce for dinner. • **"Preparing for war"** means making arrangements or getting ready for a military conflict. (युद्ध की तैयारी करना) • **Example: **The country is preparing for war by increasing its defense budget and conducting military exercises. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Indulging in corruption **(भ्रष्टाचार में लिप्त होना): Engaging in dishonest or fraudulent conduct, typically for personal gain. • **Example:** The official was fired for indulging in corruption. • **To visit the vegetable market **(सब्जी बाजार जाना): Going to a place where vegetables are sold. • **Example: **She visits the vegetable market every weekend to buy fresh produce. • **Preparing for war **(युद्ध की तैयारी करना): Making arrangements or getting ready for a military conflict. • **Example: **The nation is preparing for war due to the rising tensions at the border. 1be:T856, The correct answer is **option 3.**
